title: Plan's best month for invoice growth in 2025
prompt: For each plan, which 2025 month had the largest month-over-month increase in number of invoices issued?
population: Invoices issued from Dec 2024 through 2025 (the prior month is needed for the January comparison), joined through subscriptions to their plan.
grain: One row per plan (its single best month).
metricDefinition: month-over-month change in invoice count, per plan; the month with the largest positive change, restricted to 2025.
referenceSql: WITH plan_month AS (SELECT s.plan_id, date_trunc('month', i.issued_at) AS month, count(*) AS invoice_count FROM invoices i JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = i.subscription_id WHERE i.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-12-01' AND i.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY s.plan_id, date_trunc('month', i.issued_at)), with_change AS (SELECT plan_id, month, invoice_count, invoice_count - lag(invoice_count) OVER (PARTITION BY plan_id ORDER BY month) AS mom_change FROM plan_month), ranked AS (SELECT plan_id, month, invoice_count, mom_change, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY plan_id ORDER BY mom_change DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn FROM with_change) SELECT plan_id, month, invoice_count, mom_change FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND month >= DATE '2025-01-01' ORDER BY plan_id
